branding.tagline: Your music, carved in the dark.

children.text: A pixel player for the music you own.
No telemetry. No ads. Metadata resolved locally, streams from your plugins, and a record that turns while the track plays.
OBSIDIAN · BUILT ON SPOTUBE · YOUR LIBRARY, YOUR RULES
Built with the Spotube theme SDK. Everything here is a contract field.

Obsidian shards, the block logo and the icon set were drawn in-house, pixel by pixel.
Spotube, BYOMM, metadata resolved locally. The record turns while the track plays and holds its angle when it stops.
